_doc: Each hard route's lab numbers, as docs/research/ROUTES.md and TRADING-STYLES.md report them: the strategist's day-0 menu shows them. income is the split Board / counter / production / Georgio in % (ROUTES.md, 'Where the money comes from').

sprinter.note: the appraiser's policy with the shark's persona

armourer.note: the arms engine on the Gunsmith start: ~4 gun orders a run, Permit II at day ~62; win day +11.6 ± 9.3 against gunsmith (4 of 60 by the mortgage)

aquafarmer.note: the fish engine on the Aquafarmer start at max output (eels, sturgeon, the roe, fillerweed feed bays): ~135 fish filleted and ~9 100 of fillets a run; every win is the mortgage's end

cook.note: the Chemist start leaves the cartel: dust cooked from its caps, banked as residue, pressed on the handler's morning to his count at his purity + 10 (acid blanks set the mean); exit median day 64 in every win, then the Board buys the shop; the 3 losses are a visit with no dust

fence.note: the stolen engine on the Fence start: ~2 500 of stolen goods a run (3x outlaw), BM 40 in 36 of 60 runs; win day −1.4 ± 8.3 against outlaw, +14.6 ± 5.1 against the appraiser
